name: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) GPU Implementation
aliases: Linked nodes in linear video memory
definition: A GPU-based sparse voxel octree structure that avoids plain grid allocation by using linked nodes in linear video memory, organized into 2x2x2 node tiles and storing voxels in a 3D texture (brick pool) to allow hardware tri-linear interpolation.
summary: This GPU method implements a Sparse Voxel Octree using linked nodes in linear memory and a 3D texture brick pool to enable efficient real-time voxel cone tracing and hardware tri-linear interpolation.
